findings.title: Road to Recovery can be traced from commitment to operating services
findings.neutral_summary: Three selected resources have authoritative paths connecting the provincial model to named operating services or access pathways.
findings.why_it_matters: This is the clearest pilot proof that Miller can connect policy activity to real service access without copying the research into the client view.
findings.recommended_owner_action: Review the three paths as the reference pattern for private resource backstories.

findings.title: In Plain Sight reporting remains incomplete at recommendation level
findings.neutral_summary: B.C.'s current Action 3.07 page documents implementation activity while acknowledging that the framework cannot yet report comprehensively across all 24 recommendations.
findings.why_it_matters: The same official source supports both progress and a material reporting limitation.
findings.recommended_owner_action: Keep the chain at partial/unclear completion and prioritize the next comprehensive public update.

findings.title: FNHO has a traceable First Nations governance and federal funding path
findings.neutral_summary: The office's authority, governance, launch funding, current operation and annual-report access are documented across First Nations and federal sources.
findings.why_it_matters: It demonstrates a governance-aware evidence path that does not collapse a First Nations-led institution into a provincial program.
findings.recommended_owner_action: Use this as the reference governance-context pattern for Miller North.

findings.title: Federal coerced-sterilization bill received royal assent
findings.neutral_summary: Parliament records Bill S-228 as enacted on June 15, 2026, creating a later federal criminal-law stage relevant to—but not dispositive of—the Saskatoon accountability history.
findings.why_it_matters: It materially updates the chain's legal context while testing temporal and claim-boundary safeguards.
findings.recommended_owner_action: Add the enacted instrument as a private contextual relationship with the non-retroactivity caution intact.

findings.title: Opioid Treatment Access Line is verified beyond announcement
findings.neutral_summary: The launch, current access page and published utilization evidence demonstrate administrative creation, operation and use.
findings.why_it_matters: The path cleanly separates launch from operation and utilization.
findings.recommended_owner_action: Send the virtual provincewide candidate through normal Miller resource review.

findings.title: Patient-care quality reform is active but legislative outcome remains prospective
findings.neutral_summary: The statutory framework remains in force while a public review through 2026 considers Indigenous-specific racism and possible future legislative change.
findings.why_it_matters: It prevents a reform process from being mislabeled as an enacted legal change.
findings.recommended_owner_action: Monitor the engagement outcome and any introduced legislation.

findings.title: Creekside capacity expansion has current operational corroboration
findings.neutral_summary: Fraser Health identifies ten added beds and maintains the current facility page.
findings.why_it_matters: It is a strong named-site implementation path with capacity and later utilization context.
findings.recommended_owner_action: Retain as a high-confidence curated-resource backstory.

findings.title: CPSA source clearly separates advice from binding standards
findings.neutral_summary: The regulator's anti-racism document expressly states that it is advice, not a standard of practice or legal advice.
findings.why_it_matters: The source provides an authoritative binding-status guardrail for policy classification.
findings.recommended_owner_action: Retain binding_status and document_class as required fields in legal/government adapters.

findings.title: Oak Care operation is verified but identity reconciliation remains
findings.neutral_summary: VCH proves current operation and a 21-bed relocation, while its opening notice and current page use different street numbers and the site was described as interim.
findings.why_it_matters: Operational evidence is strong, but the resource identity should not be published until location and successor status are reconciled.
findings.recommended_owner_action: Resolve 700 versus 780 West 57th and check the successor-facility timeline.

findings.title: Inlet is listed, but its first intake milestone remains unclear
findings.neutral_summary: Official sources identify the program, operator, beds and directory listing, but the announcement described patient acceptance as a future late-summer 2026 milestone without a precise confirmation date.
findings.why_it_matters: It tests the difference between current listing and independently dated operation.
findings.recommended_owner_action: Seek an operator or Island Health notice confirming first patient intake before resource publication.

findings.title: Saskatchewan mediation terms lack later implementation evidence
findings.neutral_summary: The Commission records apology, compensation and training terms, but no later public source located in the pilot measures completion or results.
findings.why_it_matters: It is a clean example of resolution terms not equaling demonstrated implementation.
findings.recommended_owner_action: Keep training status as no clear evidence found and preserve anonymity.

findings.title: Saskatchewan legislation registry has extraction limits
findings.neutral_summary: The official source family is authoritative, but its current interface did not yield directly extractable statutory text in this pilot.
findings.why_it_matters: Authority and access reliability need separate source-registry fields.
findings.recommended_owner_action: Add a Saskatchewan statute-text retrieval fallback before the next legal pilot.
